title: Correct invalid v0.5.57 public metadata and prepare the v0.5.58 delivery path
outOfScope: Do not alter, recreate, delete, or relabel immutable v0.5.50 through v0.5.57 tags, Releases, or assets.

Do not change the test collection, coverage floor, security gates, installer gates, release gates, or failure-evidence gates. Only the declared synchronizer and release-workflow source-binding fixes and their regressions are in scope.
Do not use SKIP_QUALITY, ordinary cache hits as validation receipts, or hand-edit generated public-release evidence.

acceptance: The immutable v0.5.57 tag and Release remain unchanged and are recorded as stable_release_invalid_public_distribution because its public release.json lock hash (43548eb1f986…) does not equal the exact tagged source dependency-lock hash (b07fca668d49…).

The post-publication synchronizer promotes the provider assets while advancing install.sh and next-release consistently to v0.5.58, and records the v0.5.57 invalid-public-distribution reason and evidence without treating cache data as proof.

The release workflow independently regenerates exact-source SBOM/provenance evidence, rebinds the dependency-lock, SBOM, and provenance SHA-256 values in runtime release.json, then regenerates release-digests.json; an executable regression fails if any binding is absent.

Candidate evidence refresh updates next-release.json without mutating the provider-backed release.json projection; check-release-evidence validates the candidate digests and rejects an unrecorded invalid public projection.
Focused regressions and the declared local verification pass without reducing the test collection, coverage floor, or gates.
After archive and before merge, the hosted PR checks for this corrective change must pass on its exact head SHA; no archive Outcome, PR, or merge may claim that evidence early.
A later v0.5.58 Work Item obtains fresh same-SHA receipts, publication evidence, and a clean future-adopter HTTPS installation before Issue #783 closes.
guidelines: Keep the source-binding repair minimal, fail closed, and covered by regression tests; preserve all immutable provider evidence.
Do not claim publication, installation, or issue resolution without provider-bound evidence.

intent.problem: Provider evidence shows that v0.5.57 released stale candidate supply-chain fields in its public runtime release.json: the requirements lock digest differs from the exact tagged source. The immutable release cannot deliver trustworthy adopter evidence and must be preserved as invalid while its process defect is repaired for v0.5.58.
constraints: Preserve immutable historical releases through v0.5.56.
Do not reduce the 85.10% coverage floor, test collection, security, release, installer, Outcome, JUnit, or failure-evidence gates.
No SKIP_QUALITY or cache-as-proof; all external results must be identity-bound receipts.
The recorded human approval covers dispatch, publication, Issue closure, PR merge, and local/remote cleanup, but never permits bypassing a gate.
intent.rationale: A release is the delivery mechanism for the already-merged performance capability. Exact source-bound public metadata is a prerequisite to trustworthy artifacts and a clean future-adopter installation; v0.5.58, not the immutable invalid v0.5.57, must provide that delivery.
